title: Mujhko Tanha
body:
Baba jaan haae Baba jaan, Baba jaan haae Baba jaan
[Mujhko tanha na kabhi chodke jaana Baba] ×3
(Mujhko mehmil me bhale) - 2
tum na bithaana Baba
[Mujhko tanha na kabhi chorke jaana Baba] ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Gar khataa mujhse huwi hai to khataa maaf karo
[Maardaale na mujhe] ×2 aapka jaana Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Dekh tayyaar Sakina (s.a) hai Ali Akber (A.S.) bhi
[Hun agar ghair to tum] ×2 itna bataana Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tum se shikwa na karungi apni bimaari ka
[khud hi le lungi dawa] ×2 tum na pilaana Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Saath Asgher (A.S.) ko liye jaane ka maqsad kya hai
[Apni bimaar se tum] ×2 ye na chupaana Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Baba pardes mein Akber (A.S.) ki karo jab shaadi
(Us ghari Sughra (A.S.) ko tum) x2 bhool na jaana Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Phir agar mil na saki itni guzaarish hai meri
[Meri turbat pe diya] ×2 aake jalana Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Kaarwaan jab ye chala karbobala ay 'Yaawar'
(Sughra (A.S.) kehti thi yehi) x2 lot ke Aana Baba
